name: The Root Keeper
notes: DRAFT for C13-6 (bestiary-plan.md; lore from drafts/content/lore/guardians-and-relics.json, unchanged). Brown Guardian on floor 5. Same shape as content/enemies/floor-keeper.json, plus phases (66% and 33%, Manager's call). Stats are TODO for the Researcher. Faith tie-ins stay out until Jay decides; see faithOverlayKey.

attacks.name: page storm
attacks.note: Pages float down into small red circles, one after another.

phases.tell: A branch creaks back; red circle.

phases.counterplay: Step out of each small circle.
phases.senseiLine: Read the room. One page at a time.

phases.tell: A striped ring of roots with one gap, and double marks.
phases.senseiLine: Find the gap. Roots hold, but they open.

lines.intro: So many books, and no one to share them with.
lines.freed: Take a book, little one. Your story belongs here too.

description: The Root Keeper taps with its branches, flutters glowing pages, then grows a striped ring of roots with one gap.

bestiary.tip: Look for the gap in the roots.

lore.brown: A wise old tree who reads every book. The shadow made it forget how to share them. Free it, and its light comes home.
